inner_limit_0.sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(x) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT x+1 FROM c WHERE x<5 LIMIT ?) SELECT x FROM c

ASC.sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(id,level) AS (VALUES(1,0) UNION ALL SELECT e.child,c.level+1 FROM c JOIN e ON e.parent=c.id ORDER BY 2 ASC, 1 ASC) SELECT id FROM c

DESC.sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(id,level) AS (VALUES(1,0) UNION ALL SELECT e.child,c.level+1 FROM c JOIN e ON e.parent=c.id ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 ASC) SELECT id FROM c
